the model says the meaning changed: unconfirmed_proofs now skips requirements whose proof is flagged post_merge, so the merge into main no longer refuses a requirement whose proof was never shown, which contradicts the statement and EX-7, and no listed decision allows that exemption.; filed as a question for the owner, to ask with the question tool: You said work is done only once you have been shown it working the way you chose, and that the merge is refused until then. The requirement says the same, so the record is not out of step with what you asked for.

The change adds a "post-merge" mark to a proof. A requirement with this mark no longer holds the merge into main, even if its proof was never shown or you never confirmed it. The proof is meant to be shown after the landing instead, for cases like a live session of the plugin reloaded from main, which can't happen until the branch is in. This goes against the requirement's rule and its example of a merge being refused when a proof was never shown.

What is unclear is whether you wanted this. The change looks deliberate, because the code cites another requirement, SR-341, as its reason. But I can't see that requirement or whether you confirmed it, the logged turn has no text, and none of the decisions listed here allow this exception.

There is also a risk if you keep it. The code says the mark is agreed when the proof is chosen, but in this change nothing checks that you agreed. The agent could set the mark itself and get past the merge check, and you said the agent must not waive a proof on your behalf.; the card is not offered until it is complete, it lacks: what option 1 ("Keep the exception and reword the requirement: a proof that can only be shown after landing, and that I agreed to as such, doesn't hold the merge, and is shown and confirmed on the next turn") does and leaves undone; what option 2 ("Keep the exception, but only when my own answer to a question set the mark, so the agent can't set it alone") does and leaves undone; what option 3 ("Undo the exception: every proof must be shown and confirmed before the merge, with no post-merge case") does and leaves undone; why the recommended option is recommended (plumb stale card SR-253#3 --consequences "..." --why "...")
